watchdogExplanation: This task is a generated watchdog task. It verifies whether stopped work in the watched task tree is legitimate.
parkedBlockerExplanation: Blocked by parked work — at least one assigned blocker is in backlog and will not wake its assignee.
reviewBoundary: Low-trust review agent. It can only act inside its assigned review boundary; task, project, or run policy defines the concrete scope.
subtaskWorkspaceChange: This sub-task will no longer use the parent task workspace
repairReportingChain: Assign this agent to an active manager/root, or explicitly pause or terminate the affected agent/subtree.
createAgentsHelp: Lets this agent create or hire agents. This also grants task assignment authority.
createSkillsHelp: Lets this agent install, import, create, and scan organization skills without creating agents.
localInstructionOnly: Instructions bundles are only available for local adapters.
instructionNextRun: Saved instructions affect the next run. Active runs keep the instructions they started with, and instruction changes may start a fresh adapter session.
instructionModes: Managed: Paperclip stores and serves the instructions bundle. External: you provide a path on disk where the instructions live.
rootPathHelp: The absolute directory on disk where the instructions bundle lives. In managed mode this is set by Paperclip automatically.
entryFileHelp: The main file the agent reads first when loading instructions. Defaults to AGENTS.md.
legacyPrompt: Legacy inline prompt — this deprecated virtual file preserves the old promptTemplate content
olderEdits: Older instruction-only sessions have edits to review.
entryChanged: The instruction entry changed. These edits remain preserved for the original file.
reviewingPreserved: Reviewing preserved edits. Save to apply your resolved draft and close this preserved edit.
instructionsChanged: The current instructions changed after this draft was loaded. Refresh the current revision, compare the instructions, and save your resolved draft again.
revisionRebuild: Revision saved. The instruction file still needs to be rebuilt from the saved revision.
filePreserved: This file is preserved with the agent directory. Download it to view its contents.
keyCreated: API key created — copy it now, it will not be shown again.
keyHelp: API keys allow this agent to authenticate calls to the Paperclip server.
approvalNotified: Requesting agent was notified to review this approval and linked tasks.
linkedTasksOpen: Linked tasks remain open until the requesting agent follows up and closes them.
routinesHelp: Recurring work definitions that materialize into auditable execution tasks.
routineDraft: Define the recurring work first. Default project and agent are optional for draft routines.
policySecondary: Keep policy controls secondary to the work definition.
routineTriggerHelp: After creation, Paperclip takes you straight to trigger setup. Draft routines stay paused until you add a default agent.
accountCharges: Account-level charges that do not map to a single inference request.
currencyBoundary: Finance headline totals are USD only. Other currencies are listed separately; no exchange-rate conversion is applied.
usageStale: Showing the last loaded API and subscription usage. Updates will resume automatically.
accountsCheckFailed: Connected accounts could not be checked. Existing subscription estimates are still shown.
budgetLoadFailed: Budget data could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
dataStale: Showing the last loaded data. Updates will resume automatically.
budgetUpdateFailed: Could not update the budget. Check any pending runs or unpriced usage shown on this page, then try again.
selectDateRange: Select a start and end date to load data.
costLoadFailed: Cost data could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
policyUpdateFailed: Could not update the budget policy. Review your settings and try again.
hardStopHelp: Hard-stop spend limits for agents and projects. Provider subscription quota stays separate and appears under Providers.
resolveBudgetStop: Resolve hard stops here by raising the budget or explicitly keeping the scope paused.
noBudgetPolicies: No budget policies yet. Set agent and project budgets from their detail pages, or use the existing organization monthly budget control.
financialEventsFailed: Financial events could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
financeGrouping: Account-level financial events grouped by who charged or credited them.
sharedRunSurface: Uses the shared chat-style run surface from task activity.
